clue.text: What may lie behind writing to cut provision of regular meals?

parts.note: to cut is to clip, as with shears
board is meals provided, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: Someone proposes cutting back on the regular meals provided at a boarding house.
explanation.definitionFit: A clipboard is the stiff backing a sheet of paper rests on while you write.

clue.text: Pat holds son in such an embrace

indicators.note: one word holding another wraps around it, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: to pat is to clap lightly

explanation.surface: A parent pats the boy on the back while hugging him.
explanation.definitionFit: A clasp is a firm hold or hug, a synonym for embrace.

clue.text: Film: Summer Holiday celebrated in the US

definitions.meaning: a 1996 Hollywood alien-invasion blockbuster of that title

definitions.text: Summer Holiday celebrated in the US
definitions.meaning: the Fourth of July, the American national holiday

explanation.surface: A listing pairs a film title with a midsummer holiday in America.
explanation.walkthrough: Summer Holiday is also the title of a Cliff Richard film, which nudges you towards British films; the answer is the American one.
explanation.definitionFit: The US marks its independence each 4 July, and the 1996 film shares the holiday's name.

clue.text: Convolvulus appears in new bed I'd prepared

indicators.note: a bed prepared by the gardener is dug and reworked, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A gardener finds a weed sprouting in the freshly dug flowerbed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prepared' rearranges NEW, BED and ID (from I'd) together.
explanation.definitionFit: Convolvulus is the botanical name of the twining weed also called bellbind.

clue.text: Girl assistant supports new deal

indicators.note: in a down answer the supporting piece sits underneath the other
a new deal is a remade one, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: an aide is an assistant

explanation.surface: A young helper backs a fresh business arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns DEAL into ADEL, and 'supports' puts AIDE below it in the down light.
explanation.definitionFit: Adelaide is a woman's first name, so it serves for a girl.

clue.text: Mother's put on years, getting injury

indicators.note: in a down answer the first piece is put on top of the second

parts.note: a dam is a mother animal; the 's reads as 'is'
age means a long span of years

explanation.surface: A mother gets older and suffers a hurt in the process.
explanation.definitionFit: Damage is harm or injury done to something.

clue.text: Two identical notes with carbon copy

indicators.note: two identical things are one thing twice, so the note is repeated

parts.note: mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale
C is the chemical symbol for carbon

explanation.surface: A musician plays the same note twice and makes a carbon copy.
explanation.definitionFit: To mimic is to copy someone's manner or voice.

clue.text: A large number of milking girls turned up without helpers

indicators.note: in a down light, turned up means read from bottom to top
without means the helpers are removed

parts.note: dairymaids were the girls who milked the cows
aids are helpers

explanation.surface: A great many milkmaids arrive without anyone to help them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' takes AIDS out of DAIRYMAIDS, leaving DAIRYM; 'turned up' reverses that.
explanation.definitionFit: Myriad means a countless number, originally ten thousand in Greek.

clue.text: I'm to struggle with Channel mist to make island at high tide

indicators.note: letters that struggle thrash about, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone battles through fog in the Channel to reach a tidal island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'struggle' rearranges IM, TO, CHANNEL and MIST together, all fifteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The rocky Normandy abbey is cut off as an island when the tide is in.

clue.text: Early coach reduced risk, going without horse

indicators.note: going without means placed on the outside of the horse
reduced means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a chance is a risk
an Arab is a breed of horse

explanation.surface: A primitive coach was less risky once it had no horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside, not lacking: the shortened word for risk is wrapped around the horse, and 'reduced' drops its final E.
explanation.definitionFit: A charabanc was an early open motor coach used for outings.

clue.text: Possibly bitter about cavity that's not so easy on the teeth

definitions.text: not so easy on the teeth

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the beer goes round the hollow

parts.note: bitter is a type of ale, so ale is possibly bitter
a dent is a hollow or cavity

explanation.surface: A bitter drink worries someone with a hole in a tooth.
explanation.walkthrough: Bitter is a British style of beer, a kind of ale.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasta cooked al dente still offers some firmness to the bite.

clue.text: Issue of Prospero's devising in drama

indicators.note: devising means making something out of them, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A note on how Prospero's scheming drives the plot of a play.
explanation.definitionFit: Miranda is Prospero's daughter in The Tempest, and issue means offspring.

clue.text: Nonsense with Washington over fruit tree

parts.note: pap is worthless or trivial talk

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: WA is the postal abbreviation for Washington state

explanation.surface: A dispute over a fruit tree turns into nonsense involving Washington.
explanation.definitionFit: The papaw, or pawpaw, is a tropical fruit tree.

clue.text: It held up the Greek fleet on its way to Troy

definitions.text: It held up the Greek fleet on its way to Troy

parts.words: It held up the Greek fleet on its way to Troy
parts.note: seems to mean something delayed the ships; really the water they floated on held them up

explanation.definitionFit: The Greeks sailed to Troy across this arm of the Mediterranean, which bore their ships up.

clue.text: Suggestive remark on nude in play

indicators.note: letters at play move freely, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone makes a saucy comment about the naked scene in a stage play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'play' rearranges ON, NUDE and IN together.
explanation.definitionFit: An innuendo is a remark that hints at something, often rude.

clue.text: I name personal assistant in telegram as lacking ability

parts.note: I is taken as written

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside another

parts.note: a cable is a telegram

explanation.surface: A boss names an assistant in a telegram as being useless.
explanation.definitionFit: Incapable means unable to do something, lacking the ability.

clue.text: Is admitted to part of US, having this?

definitions.text: Is admitted to part of US, having this?

indicators.note: admitted to means let inside, so the word goes within the state

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for Virginia, a US state

explanation.surface: A traveller is let into an American state because of a document.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: this document is what gets you admitted to the US.
explanation.definitionFit: A visa is the endorsement that lets a foreigner enter a country.

clue.text: Boy, Hallo organised sensational publicity

indicators.note: organised means put into a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A lad's greeting is arranged as a media stunt.
explanation.definitionFit: Ballyhoo is noisy hype or showy publicity.

clue.text: Southern Frenchman is G&S fan

definitions.meaning: a native of Savoy, a region in the south-east of France
an enthusiast for Gilbert and Sullivan operas, first staged at the Savoy Theatre in London

explanation.surface: A man from the south of France turns out to love comic operetta.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a person from Savoy and a devotee of Gilbert and Sullivan.

clue.text: At the home of revolutionary leader of Zapata's

parts.note: Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A revolutionary is found at the house of Zapata, the Mexican rebel leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Chez is French for at the house of, used in English too.

clue.text: Girl has to perform in charge of star system

parts.note: gal is an informal word for girl
to act is to perform

explanation.surface: A young woman must act as the boss of a group of stars.
explanation.definitionFit: Galactic means relating to a galaxy, a vast system of stars.

clue.text: Commanding officer keen to get in right troops

indicators.note: to get in means to be placed inside

parts.note: hot means keen, as in hot on something

explanation.surface: An eager commander wants his soldiers to fall in properly.
explanation.definitionFit: A cohort was a Roman army unit, so a body of troops.

clue.text: What turns red with acid burning has raised problem

parts.note: lit means alight or burning

indicators.note: raised means lifted, so in a down light the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: A chemistry student has a burning question about a test paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Litmus is the dye that turns red in acid and blue in alkali.

clue.text: Place outside London station not initially illustrated

indicators.note: outside means the abbreviation goes around the rest

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for Place in street names

indicators.note: not initially means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: Victoria is a major London railway terminus

explanation.surface: A spot just outside a London terminus lacks pictures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not initially' drops the V, and 'outside' places what is left inside P and L. Victoria is a mainline London terminus.
explanation.definitionFit: Pictorial means containing or expressed in pictures.

clue.text: Drug is very best I provided for Tim

indicators.note: I provided for Tim means I is put in place of the letters of Tim

parts.note: optimum means the very best

explanation.surface: Someone supplies Tim with the best narcotic.
explanation.walkthrough: In OPTIMUM, the letters TIM are swapped for I, giving OPIUM. 'provided for' means 'substituted for' here, not 'supplied to'.
explanation.definitionFit: Opium is a narcotic drug made from poppies.

clue.text: Second fish is an eel

parts.note: mo is short for moment, a second
the ray is a flat fish

explanation.surface: A second fish turns out to be an eel.
explanation.definitionFit: A moray is a kind of large, often fierce eel.

clue.text: Place in home for those who are down and out?

definitions.text: Place in home for those who are down and out?

parts.words: Place in home for those who are down and out?
parts.note: suggests a shelter for the destitute; really the room for people lying down and out cold asleep

explanation.definitionFit: This is where you lie down in bed and sleep, dead to the world.

clue.text: Girl's article impounded by judge

indicators.note: impounded by means shut up within the other word

parts.note: to hear a case is to judge it
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A girl's belongings are confiscated by a magistrate.
explanation.definitionFit: Heather is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Part of Africa — for instance, unknown part

parts.note: eg is the abbreviation for for example
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: An atlas entry gives an example of an unexplored region of Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Egypt is a country in the north-east of Africa.

clue.text: Repartee in Brand?

definitions.meaning: witty back-and-forth argument, a fencing match of words
brand is an old word for a sword, and Brand is a play by Ibsen

explanation.surface: Quick-witted banter in a play called Brand.
explanation.definitionFit: Swordplay means fencing, and figuratively a lively exchange of witty remarks.
